item: Restore merge: a curated-catalogue stamp gives way to another instance's MEASURED verdict, so a measured disqualification no longer lands beside a live qualified (diagnostics rank 14, C52)
status: SHIPPED (reproduced with merge_corpus first; field effect pending the instances' next import)
summary: Field: qualification-integrity.json reported inversions-found on two instances (psx.com.pk, law.go.kr, wiadomosci.onet.pl: live qualified, last judged disqualified), all stamped oo-curated-catalog-1. Reproduced exactly with the real merge_corpus: the adoption UPDATE only fired where the local status was unqualified, and a curated stamp is status qualified, so the incoming measured disqualification landed in the attempt history beside a live qualified. Fix: a local stamp that is the catalogue's default (qualified + oo-curated-catalog-1) is adoptable by an incoming stamp that is not unqualified and not curated, in both directions, the same rule qualification_overlay already applies; the tally (adopted, kept, disagreed) uses the same predicate. A locally measured verdict still wins, and an incoming curated stamp replaces nothing. The give-way is blocked when the local row's newest JUDGING attempt is at least as new as the incoming evidence and disagrees (ties keep local), because the merge copies the incoming attempts and adopting over a newer local judgement would create the opposite inversion. One import-report sentence was reworded. Eleven tests; the two core ones fail without the change. Known limit: two separate sequential imports can still invert (see qualification-integrity.json and the boot repair in PR #1281).
